original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹Pariang附近村庄遭武装袭击，至少8死7伤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹鲁翁行政区Pariang镇附近的Panlou村发生武装袭击，当地当局称至少8人死亡、7人受伤。袭击于周二晚约10时发生，持续约四小时后袭击者逃往邻近的团结州。当局称袭击者疑似来自团结州Mayom县，但Mayom县专员表示未证实该说法。

location.raw_text: Panlou village near Pariang town in South Sudan’s Ruweng Administrative Area

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹Pariang镇附近Panlou村遭武装袭击，至少8人死亡、7人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least eight people were killed and seven others injured in an armed attack on Panlou village near Pariang town in South Sudan’s Ruweng Administrative Area, local authorities said on Friday.

key_facts.fact: 袭击于周二晚约10时发生，战斗持续约四小时，至周三凌晨约2时结束
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The attack occurred at about 10 p.m. on Tuesday... The fighting lasted about four hours, ending at around 2 a.m. on Wednesday, before the attackers fled towards neighbouring Unity State

key_facts.fact: 当局称袭击者疑似来自团结州Mayom县，两名疑似袭击者被活捉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Chol said the attackers were suspected of coming from Mayom County in Unity State. He added that two suspected attackers had been captured alive by armed youths

key_facts.fact: Mayom县专员称未证实Mayom人员参与袭击的说法
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: John Bol Mayak, the caretaker commissioner of Mayom County, said he had heard reports of the incident before arriving in the county on Thursday but did not confirm the alleged involvement of people from Mayom.

uncertainties: 袭击者是否来自团结州Mayom县尚未证实，Mayom县专员未确认该说法
事件目前为单一来源报道（Radio Tamazuj），尚缺乏交叉验证
